FAQ

Questions about hotel software

Short, direct answers.

What is a hotel property management system (PMS)?

A PMS handles reservations, front desk, housekeeping, billing and reports for a hotel. Sarvlekh builds PMS and connected F&B, laundry and accounting for hotels of any size.

Can it connect to OTAs?

We build channel-ready rate and inventory structures and integrate with channel managers of your choice.

Does it handle GST invoicing?

Yes. Slab-correct GST invoices and Tally exports are included.

Can the hotel system be customised to our way of working?

Yes. Every Sarvlekh system is shaped around your workflow — modules, roles, reports and approvals are configured with you, not imposed on you.

Can Sarvlekh connect the hotel system to Tally and GST?

Yes. Sales, purchase and payment entries flow into Tally automatically and GST-ready invoices are generated from the same data.

How quickly can we go live?

A focused first release usually goes live in weeks. We start with the modules that remove the most manual work and expand in stages.
